count_source: Difference in canonical site_usage reservations for jevlint_review before/after each serialized run; conservative attempts, not an independently reconciled vendor bill.

findings.description: Fail a project-local helper whose complete implementation only calls another helper with the same caller-supplied arguments and returns its result, adding no policy, validation, transformation or error translation. Calling a canonical validator through a new alias is still forwarding. A function that directly implements a data lookup or validation is implementation, not forwarding, even if short.
findings.name: allowed
findings.snippet:
def allowed(command, cwd, repo, scratch_roots=()):
    return command_spec(command, cwd, repo, scratch_roots) is not None
